summary: Samples CHOP channels using POP attribute values as lookup indices, then writes the sampled and optionally reranged values back into POP attributes. Lookup indices may be normalized 0-1 values or sample indices.

key_params.name: cyclic
key_params.note: Wraps lookup indices across the channel range

key_params.name: interpolate
key_params.note: Interpolate between CHOP samples instead of nearest sample

key_params.name: lookup0chanscope
key_params.note: Channel pattern sampled by the first lookup block

key_params.name: lookup0outputattrscope
key_params.note: Output POP attribute scope for sampled values

key_concepts: Uses a POP lookup index attribute to sample values from channels in a referenced CHOP.
Normalized index mode spans first-to-last CHOP sample; sample-index mode addresses absolute sample numbers.
Channel Scope chooses which CHOP channels are sampled and Output Attribute Scope maps those values back into POP attributes.
Sequential lookup blocks can interpolate, extend, and rerange sampled channel values before output.
common_gotchas: Normalized indices map 0 to the first CHOP sample and 1 to the last; switch to Sample Index for absolute sample addressing.
Out-of-range lookup behavior is controlled by extend menus; do not assume values clamp automatically.
Sequential lookup blocks can rerange channel values before writing, so inspect output scopes before stacking more math.
